name: Bloodfeather Belt
summary: In northern Teldrassil, Bloodfeather harpies crowd the Oracle Glade in crude leather belts. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak gathers the belts as proof that nearby nests are being cleared.

sections.title: Trophies from the Nests
sections.body: Bloodfeather harpies have made aggressive nests in the boughs around the Oracle Glade. Their presence threatens the ancient Oracle Tree and blocks travel through northern Teldrassil. After the flock ambushed and killed a runner carrying reports to Darnassus, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak called on travelers to strike at the nests. Belts taken from fallen harpies show the flock is being thinned and the paths secured, so messages can reach the capital again.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak want these belts?
faq.answer: Arynia Cloudsbreak and her small detachment of Sentinels guard the sacred Oracle Tree against nearby Bloodfeather nests. After the harpies killed a messenger bound for Darnassus, Arynia asks travelers to bring back belts as proof that the nests are being cleared and the flock thinned.

faq.q: Where do Bloodfeather Belts come from?
faq.answer: Bloodfeather harpies in the trees and crags around the Oracle Glade in northern Teldrassil carry these belts. Every kind in the flock wears one, including wind witches, sorceresses, rogues, and furies.

faq.q: Why are harpies a problem in the Oracle Glade?
faq.answer: The harpies have nested close to the Oracle Tree, an ancient tree that watches over the health of the World Tree. Their aggression isolates the Sentinels guarding the glade and violently disrupts messages bound for Darnassus.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, reclaiming the Oracle Glade from the Bloodfeather coven is a duty. Their nests have defiled Teldrassil’s natural canopy.
As an Alliance member, helping Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak lets vital reports from Teldrassil’s ancient trees reach Darnassus’s leaders without interruption.
